summary: Flex Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $1.45 billion senior delayed draw term loan credit agreement to finance its previously disclosed acquisition of Electrical Power Products, Inc. The credit facility matures 364 days after initial funding, with floating-rate interest based on Term SOFR or Base Rate plus a margin tied to Flex's debt ratings. Covenants include a Debt/EBITDA ratio not exceeding 4.00x and an Interest Coverage ratio of at least 3.00x. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes including the EP acquisition. The filing provides the financing structure for the pending acquisition; watch for the EP acquisition closing and Flex's leverage trajectory.
